harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 9.8), installed from upstream GitHub release binaries and run as a systemd service (etcd.service, user 'etcd', data in /var/lib/etcd), with firewalld opened for 2379/2380. Verified full mesh replication (writes from each node readable on the other two), verified the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down (stopped node3, wrote/read against node1+node2, then restarted node3 and confirmed it caught up to the same raft index). Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/health on all nodes, sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time (preserving quorum throughout), confirmed changed boot_id after each, and confirmed etcd + cluster health + all previously written keys (foo, fromnode2, fromnode3, duringoutage) were present and consistent (raft index 38 on all three) after every restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries (etcd, etcdctl, etcdutl) on node1, node2, node3 from GitHub releases
Created etcd system user, /var/lib/etcd data dir, /etc/etcd/etcd.conf per-node static bootstrap config
Created and enabled etcd.service systemd unit on all three nodes
Opened firewalld ports 2379/tcp and 2380/tcp on all three nodes
Started all three etcd members simultaneously to bootstrap the 3-member cluster; verified member list and cluster health
Wrote keys from each of the three nodes and read them back from the other two nodes to prove cross-member consistency

Stopped node3's etcd, wrote/read a key against node1+node2 to prove availability during a member outage, then restarted node3 and confirmed it fully caught up (same raft applied index as the other two)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd/cluster health baseline on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time, preserving quorum) via systemctl reboot
Polled each node until it came back and confirmed boot_id changed after each restart
Verified etcd, cluster health, member list, and all previously written keys (foo, fromnode2, fromnode3, duringoutage) after each node's restart, with matching raft index across all members at the end

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: etcd v3.5.17 installed on all three nodes; member list shows all three (node1, node2, node3) as started with correct peer/client addrs; endpoint health true for all three.

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Wrote 'foo' on node1, read back correctly on node2 and node3; wrote 'fromnode2' on node2, read back on node1 and node3; wrote 'fromnode3' on node3, read back on node1 and node2.

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3 (verified inactive); with node3 down, endpoint health for node1/node2 still true and a new key 'duringoutage' was successfully written and read back against the remaining two members.

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up (resynchronization) when it returns
evidence.summary: Restarted node3's etcd; after restart it reports health true, returns the keys written while it was down ('duringoutage', 'foo'), and endpoint status shows identical raft term/index/applied-index (2/20/20) across all three members, proving full resync.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf4e9cbb... and healthy etcd/cluster captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed = ack); post-reboot boot_id 096cd853... confirms restart; etcd active again, cluster health true for all endpoints, key 'foo' intact, member list unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6bb7e004... and healthy etcd/cluster captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed = ack); post-reboot boot_id 11c2ea15... confirms restart; etcd active again, cluster health true for all endpoints, key 'foo' intact, member list unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart (second/final restart cycle): healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state and full cluster health/quorum
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c... and healthy etcd/cluster captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed = ack); post-reboot boot_id 119506f3... confirms restart; etcd active again, cluster health true for all endpoints, all keys (foo, fromnode2, fromnode3, duringoutage) present, and endpoint status shows matching raft term/index/applied-index (5/38/38) across all three members, proving full cluster recovery and quorum.
